newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Nov 5 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 27 ft. 4 ins. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 28 ft. 8 ins. at passage km 520. San Lorenzo - Six vessels berthed, all loading, of which 1 sun oil, 3 sbpm, 1 sbm, 1 sbo. 5 Vessels in roads, 14 due at 9 terminals during the coming week. Max. recommended aft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Pasa's berth draft, 23 ft. 3 ins. fw,. Nidera's berth draft/El Transito's berth, also guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Rosario - Six vessels berthed of which 3 awaiting orders. 3 Loading (1 wheat, 1 sbmp, 1 sbm). 1 Vessel in roads, 7 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

Villa Constitucion - One vessel berthed discharging iron ore, no vessels in roads, 1 due. Max recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Elevator berths, max. draft 22 ft.fw. San Nicolas - One vessel berthed discharging iron ore. 2 in roads, 7 due within next week. Ma. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Pedro - No vessels berthed/in roads/due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Mitre channel Max drafts as follows (high tide) 31 ft. 6 ins./32 ft fw. Buenos Aires - 20 vessels in port, 30 due in next week. Max. recoended draft 31 ft. 6 ins. fw. high tide. Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock sud, 29 ft fw. high tide. Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Three vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 sbmp, 1 discharging fertiliser. 3 in roads, 4 due within the next week. Max. draft 40 ft. Bahia Blanca - Three vessels berthed of which 1 loading sun pellets, 1 discharging urea, 1 loading naphtha, no vessels in roads. 11 due within the next week, draft depends on individual berth.

BRAZIL, Nov 5 - Vitoria - Six vessels berthed of which 1 cellulose loader, 1 container/general cargo loader/discharger, 1 sugar loader, 1 malt discharger, 1 fruit discharger, 1 wheat discharger. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders - Praia mole - 3 Steel plate loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - 1 Iron ore vessel. 17 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - 43 vessels berthed of which 8 full containers, 3 general cargo, 1 bulk cement discharger. 14 Sugar loaders, 4 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 juice loaders, 4 wheat dischargers, 1 propane discharger, 1 pellets discharger, 1 diesel oil loader, 1 salt discharger, 1 steel products loader, 1 chemical products discharger, 1 jute discharger. 14 waiting in roads, 91 due over the next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 2 steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Itajai - Three berthed of which 2 reefers, 1 full container. 6 waiting in roads, 12 due over the next 7 days. Rio Grande - 11 vessels berthed of which 4 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 full containers, 1 soy loader, 1 wheat transhipment, 2 acid dischargers, 1 soyoil loader, 1 barley discharger. 4 waiting in roads, 21 due over next 10 days. Paranagua - 11 vessels berthed of which 4 pellets loaders, 1 sugar loader, 1 reefer loader, 2 fertiliser dischargers, 1 full container discharger, 2 general cargo dischargers. 25 waiting in roads of which 15 to load (6 sugar, 8 pellets, 1 general cargo). 10 To discharge (8 fertiliser, 2 containers).

Rio de Janeiro - Ten vessels berthed of which 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 2 general cargo/container dischargers, 1 salt discharger, 1 oil discharger, 1 paper discharger, 2 steel products loaders, 1 containers/steel products loader. Tecon - 3 Vessels. 26 due over the next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 4 berthed. Commercial quay - 1 berthed, 4 waiting in roads, 8 due over next 7 days.

CHILE, Nov 4 - Arica - Two vessels in port operating, 2 berths vacant, no swell, 6 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Two vessels in port operating, no berths vacant, 5 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed and 2 berths vacant. 8 Vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers, general cargo, no vessels in roads awaiting cargo. Valparaiso - Five vessels berthed and working normally, 1 berth vacant, 1 out of service until April 1997 due to enlargement of pier 3. 14 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Six vessels in port operating, 1 anchored in roads, 11 due during the week, port busy but no waiting time. Puerto Montte - Two vessels in port, no berths vacant, no vessels waiting in roads, 3 due during the week.

Punta Arenas - Two vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 1 berth vacant. 3 vessels and coasters due during week, none waiting in roads. Conception Bay - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed, 2 due this week, none in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed and working normally, 1 vacant. No vessels waiting in roads, 3 due in week. Navy pier (molo 500) - no vessels at terminal. Steel pier - No vessels at terminal, 1 berth vacant. Coronel pier - No vessels loading wood-pulp. Oil terminal - No vessels, none due in week. Lirquen - Four operating, 2 berths vacant. No vessels in roads awaiting berths, 1 cargo vessel due. Penco - No vessels at terminal.

PERU, Nov 4 - No strikes in any port. Callao - Five vessels anchored, 4 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored. 2 Sulphate/general cargo vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Talara, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels, no delays. Chimbote - One vessel anchored, 2 fish meal vessels berthed, no delays.

VENEZUELA, Nov 5 - All ports working normally. Orinoco river draft 5/11 34 ft 5 ins. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels loading iron ore, 3 due. Boca Grande - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 due. Matanzas - Six vessels operating of which 5 loading steel products, 1 discharging pitch, 3 due. Venalum - Two operating of which 1 loading aluminium, 1 loading/discharging general cargo, 1 due. San Felix - Three vessels due. Alcasa - One due. Puerto Cabello - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 11 operating of which 9 loading/discharging general cargo, 1 discharging malt, 1 sugar, 29 due.

Guanta - Four vessels operating of which 1 discharging tuna, 3 loading general cargo, 5 due. La Guaira - One vessel loading steel bars, 11 due, 3 under repairs. Maracaibo - One vessel due. Puerto Miranda - Two vessels loading crude. Bajo Grande - Two vessels due. El Tablazo - One vessel loading urea. La Salina - One loading crude. Buoy B71 - One loading coal. Punta Palma, Punta Camacho, San Lorenzo, San Francisco, La Ceiba - No vessels. Cardon - Three vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 Loading refined products. Amuay - No information received.
